'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
*****The delegations of the [[Iran]] and the [[United States]] arrive in [[Islamabad]], [[Pakistan]], for [[ceasefire]] [[Islamabad Talks|talks]], the highest-level engagement between the two countries since the [[Iranian Revolution]] in 1979, with the Iranian delegation led by [[List of speakers of the Parliament of Iran|parliament speaker]] [[Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf]] and [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] and the U.S. delegation led by [[Vice President of the United States|vice president]] [[JD Vance]]. [https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2639522/pakistan (''Arab News PK'')]
*****The first round of talks end without a peace deal, but is expected to continue into Sunday night. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/11/us-iran-talks-set-to-begin-in-islamabad-after-delegations-arrive.html (CNBC)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[Operation Urja Suraksha]]
*****[[India]]-flagged [[Liquefied petroleum gas|LPG]] [[Gas carrier|gas tanker]] ''Jag Vikram'' crosses the Strait of Hormuz, becoming the first Indian vessel to cross the [[Strait of Hormuz]] since the [[ceasefire]]. It is expected to arrive in [[Mumbai]] on April 15. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/mumbai-news/1st-indian-vessel-crosses-hormuz-strait-after-us-iran-ceasefire-101775935854648-amp.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] says that the U.S. has begun "clearing out" [[naval mine]]s in the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/us-clearing-out-strait-of-hormuz-trump-/3902097 (AA)]
****The [[United States Central Command|U.S. Central Command]] confirms that the [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] {{sclass|Arleigh Burke|destroyer}}s [[USS Frank E. Petersen Jr.|USS ''Frank Peterson'']] and [[USS Michael Murphy|USS ''Michael Murphy'']] have crossed the [[Strait of Hormuz]] to ensure the strait is clear of naval mines. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/us-confirms-destroyers-passed-through-strait-of-hormuz-as-it-works-to-de-mine-the-key-waterway/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/trump-says-us-forces-are-clearing-strait-hormuz-2026-04-11/ (Reuters)] [https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PRESS-RELEASES/Press-Release-View/Article/4457220/us-forces-start-mine-clearance-mission-in-strait-of-hormuz/ (CENTCOM)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****At least ten people, including three [[first responder|emergency worker]]s, are killed by [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s across [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/11/israel-rejects-ceasefire-with-hezbollah-ahead-of-lebanon-talks-next-week (Al Jazeera)]
****The [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli army]] has reportedly [[Battle of Bint Jbeil (2026)|encircled]] [[Bint Jbeil]], a [[Hezbollah]] stronghold in southern Lebanon. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/reports-israeli-troops-surround-hezbollah-105221160.html (DPA via Yahoo News)]
****Israel rejects a ceasefire with Hezbollah. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/11/israel-rejects-ceasefire-with-hezbollah-ahead-of-lebanon-talks-next-week (Al Jazeera)]
****The [[Government of Lebanon|Lebanese government]] reports that the death toll from the war has surpassed 2,000 people. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/death-toll-lebanon-surpasses-2000 (''Middle East Eye'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Protests against the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iranian diaspora protests]]
***Amidst the [[Islamabad Talks|Islamabad ceasefire talks]], [[Iranian diaspora]] protesters gather in [[Bangkok]], [[Thailand]] to reaffirm their calls for [[Regime change efforts in the 2026 Iran war|regime change]]. [https://www.thaiexaminer.com/thai-news-foreigners/2026/04/12/iranian-protesters-at-us-embassy-in-bangkok-oppose-pakistan-talks-and-want-to-see-the-hated-regime-ousted/ (''Thai Examiner'')]
**[[Anti-war movement|Anti-war]] and anti-government protests against [[Prime Minister of Israel|prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] occur across [[Israel]], including 2,000 protesters at [[Habima Square]] in [[Tel Aviv]] that exceeded court-ordered limits. Protests also occur in [[Jerusalem]] and [[Haifa]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/thousands-protest-government-and-iran-war-in-tel-aviv-exceeding-court-ordered-limits/amp/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[2026 Djiboutian presidential election]]
**Preliminary results released after yesterday's presidential election reveal that incumbent [[President of Djibouti|president]] [[Ismaïl Omar Guelleh]] has won a sixth term in office with 97.81% of the vote, beating CDU candidate Mohamed Farah Samatar, who took 2.19% of the vote. [https://apnews.com/article/djibouti-election-guelleh-56800757f1108c104adb4bdc5ae880fa (AP)] [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20260410-djibouti-leader-claims-sixth-straight-term (France 24)]
*[[2026 Iraqi presidential election]]
**The [[Council of Representatives (Iraq)|Council of Representatives]] elects [[Patriotic Union of Kurdistan|PUK]] candidate [[Nizar Amidi]] as [[president of Iraq]] in the second round, defeating Muthana Amin of the [[Kurdistan Islamic Union]] in a 227–15 vote. [https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/story/907256/puk-candidate-nizar-amedi-elected-president-of-iraq-in-parliamentary-vote (Kurdistan24)] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/politics/nizar-amidi-elected-iraqs-president/3902198 (AA)]
